project.name: Request-FP
project.description: Easy, safe HTTP requests for Free Pascal

banner.alt: Request-FP: easy HTTP for Free Pascal

identity.footer: Request-FP is MIT licensed. Built for Free Pascal and Lazarus developers.

capabilities.title: One line per request
capabilities.description: Http.Get, PostJSON, Download: records clean themselves up, no Free needed.

capabilities.title: Resilient by default
capabilities.description: Safe retries with backoff, Retry-After, typed timeout and network errors.

capabilities.title: Big files, small memory
capabilities.description: Stream downloads and uploads straight to and from disk, with progress.

capabilities.title: Sessions that behave
capabilities.description: Cookies follow Domain and Path; credentials never leak across hosts.
